contract.description: Tachyon eggs were needed for a wide array of products this season, to spend more (or less) time with family. Resupply orders are in!

contract.name: Pumpkin Pie
contract.description: (2019) It's that time of year, when what is widely considered the greatest pie hits center stage: Pumpkin Pie.

contract.description: (2020) The economy is taking a hit and the government is buying up loads of eggs to keep everyone afloat!

contract.name: Palisades Forever
contract.description: Houses have burned to the ground, but the community is unbroken - they'll want to rebuild with the latest materials!

contract.description: (2021) Bodybuilders are switching to Superfood Egg diets after discovering a new Amino Acid in the egg. Orders are surging!

contract.description: As more reusable rockets are developed, launch prices decrease, launches increase, and demand for fuel increases!

contract.name: Never Enough
contract.description: Stores thought they had enough... there are never enough.

contract.description: (2023) A massive desert arts festival was flooded leaving thousands stranded without enough supplies - Superfood eggs are being air dropped in!

contract.description: A recent disaster has tripled hazardous material removal needs, super capacity carriers use Quantum Eggs to maximize storage.

contract.name: Quantum Monday
contract.description: (2020) With nearly all Holiday shopping happening online, Quantum storage solutions are in high demand!

contract.name: Stuffed
contract.description: (2019) Folks have been over-eating for days and are looking for lighter meals, Superfood eggs are flying off the shelves

contract.name: Backup
contract.description: Home battery backup demands are re-doubling after recent disasters highlighted the need for grid independence

contract.name: Pumpkin Cheesecake
contract.description: (2022) Pumpkin Cheesecake is the trendy desert this Thanksgiving, once again surprising suppliers who need more Pumpkin Eggs!

contract.description: (2018) Thanksgiving has left the world with too many leftovers, quantum Tupperware is sold out everywhere, and more raw materials are needed.

contract.description: (2020) As the leaves change color so do the eggs. Help meet seasonal demand!

contract.description: (2020) Tasty holiday food and drink such as Egg Nog and Noodle Kugel are spiking demand for regular eggs!

contract.name: Last Minute Decoration

contract.name: Home Renovations
contract.description: (2018) You've decided to build a new house! Why not make it yourself? You'll need a lot of eggs so get started!

contract.name: Presidential Visit
contract.description: Time tourists are visiting the recent and not-so recent past to remind themselves of the incredible contributions of our Nation's Presidents

contract.name: Black Fried Egg
contract.description: (2022) In store and online deals led to record holiday sales - factories are adding shifts to restock goods - supplies are needed!

contract.name: Quantum Pump
contract.description: From Cities to apartment owners, everyone wants these new hose-less water pumps!

contract.name: Racing Ramp
contract.description: From Formula 1 to the World Endurance Championship, racing teams are ramping production of new and spare parts!

contract.name: R.N.Egg
contract.description: (2022) Gene editing technologies have been adapted to use Immortality Eggs to correct genetic diseases. Supplies are needed!

contract.name: Space Bots
contract.description: (2020) New tiny space robots have been developed to explore space, small enough to be launched with traditional fuels!

contract.description: (2019) Smaller settlements all over the galaxy still use Fusion Egg Reactors and are running short of Fusion Eggs!

contract.name: Hangover Cure

contract.name: Domestic Production
contract.description: Geopolitics have led to increased prices for imports driving some to source alternative - if expensive - materials!

contract.description: Young people love the long evenings, and folks are looking to get trim for increased night life, clean diets are taking off!

contract.description: Easter Egg orders are coming in early this year, as many are trying to get ahead of the price gouging near the day

contract.name: Quantum Payload
contract.description: (2021) With the recent boom in Artifacts exploration, quantum crates are in mass production!

contract.name: Quantum Trash Bags
contract.description: (2018) With all the wrapping paper and boxes to throw out, Quantum Trash bags are flying off the shelves!

contract.name: Spring Arrives

contract.name: Halloween Blitz
contract.description: (2018) Pumpkin demand is overwhelming! A quick contract for big money!

contract.name: Not Enough
contract.description: The recent California wildfires made Egg Scientists realize Waterballoons are not enough. They came up with something new...

contract.name: Saving Daylight

contract.name: Tariff Shuffle
contract.description: A pending trade war has international shipping companies slammed, moving as much as possible before the looming deadlines!

contract.name: Housing Boom!

contract.name: Eggstinction

contract.name: Eggscavator

contract.name: Five Five

contract.name: Private Food
contract.description: (2023) A chef services provider is buying direct and wondering if you're interested?

contract.name: Alt Fertilizer
contract.description: The search for better fertilizers has led one producer to figure out a formula that uses Super Material eggs! Long term contracts are out.

contract.name: Summer Jump
contract.description: Summer Diets are starting early this year and more Superfood farmers are needed!

contract.description: (2021) With Trillions of Cicadas descending on the North Eastern US, millions flee to the quietest place possible... The Moon.

contract.name: Egg Days

contract.name: Summer Nesting

contract.name: Hot Fireworks
contract.description: (2020) With a surge in at-home fireworks shows, burn treatments are flying off the shelves, help restock!

contract.name: Quantum Shelf

contract.name: Egg Day 2018
contract.description: (2018) Some folks like to celebrate Egg Day with a bang!

contract.description: A play-structure manufacturer is revolutionizing playground equipment with advanced materials, they are looking for a supplier.

contract.name: Summer Heat
contract.description: (2019) With summer heat in full swing, AC is running non stop and some power plants need more fuel!

contract.description: An entertainment company is starting its most ambitious project yet: an amusement park in space. Supplies are needed!

contract.description: (2023) As Omega 3 rich diets gain popularity, Superfood eggs are seen as a top breakfast, orders are surging

contract.description: A breakthrough Medical Egg based drug cures many mental illnesses simply by making the patient repulsed by social media.

contract.description: With the leaves falling, compost bins are overflowing, until now. The manufacturers of Quantum Compost bins need supplies!

contract.description: (2021) A recent oil pipeline hijacking has lead to a spike in Fusion Car sales and subsequent fuel demand!

contract.description: As vendors strive to be the one stop shop for all their client's merch manufacturing needs, they're needing to lean on more advanced materials.

contract.name: Anti-Tardy
contract.description: Tardies are a thing of the past with these 5 minute literal time savers, you'll never be late to school again!

contract.description: An eccentric billionaire is hoarding wood eggs due to their unintended efficient capture and store of carbon!

contract.description: Despite all market research, Chocolate reins supreme as the #1 Halloween Candy, with suppliers scrapping for more, will you help?

contract.description: An indoor kart racing league is building their next-gen karts out of CF, and they're looking for a longtime supplier!

contract.description: (2019) Satellite Constellation Internet is all the rage in commercial space flight! Help fuel the launches!

contract.name: Egg Sandwich
contract.description: This ski season, the popularity of this warm high protein lunch is straining egg supplies. New producers are needed!

contract.description: Desktop PC components are expected to be a huge hit this holiday as the trend of building your own gains momentum!

contract.name: Quantum Slopes
contract.description: An innovate ski resort is at it again, this time phase shifting entire runs so a skier or group can appear to have the run to themselves!

contract.description: (2023) Food suppliers are getting ahead of the diet shift that always comes after Memorial day, and bonuses are being offered for Super Food Egg contracts!

contract.description: Montessori toys are trending this year, turns out they are just normal toys but made of wood that cost 4x as much!

contract.description: One-off custom 3d printed Christmas toys are all the rage, and perfectly timed with this new filament egg formula!

contract.description: (2021) On the longest day of the year (northern hemisphere), it has become tradition to celebrate time itself with various Tachyon Egg activities!
